title: 第0362章 岛民迎接欢庆胜利第0361章 凰溪荣耀衣锦还乡
content_zh:
凰溪岛的海风，永远带着独有的湿润暖意。
蔚蓝海面波光粼粼，远处废土交界的灰雾被正午烈阳彻底驱散，澄澈天幕之下，跨海观光大桥笔直横跨海面，连接着主城与这座边境修行圣地。
今日的凰溪岛，和往日截然不同。
没有度假区游客的嬉闹喧哗，没有武道学徒日常的刻苦呼喝，整座海岛从上到下，都弥漫着一股沸腾到极致的热烈氛围。
主干道两侧早已人山人海，沿街商铺全部自发停业，数万岛民齐聚街道两旁，翘首以盼，目光死死锁定跨海大桥的尽头。
彩旗沿街高悬，红色横幅随风烈烈作响，笔墨铿锵，写满了凰溪岛所有人的骄傲与振奋。
【恭迎凰溪少年，武道高考凯旋！
【贾黑米、才依依，我岛双骄，荣归故里！
【少年破壁，寒门逆袭，凰溪荣光再续！
消息传回凰溪岛的那一刻，整座海岛彻底炸锅。
无人不知，今年的全国武道高考，是百年以来最凶险、最诡异的一届。
考前多地爆发心灵低语乱象，考场暗藏邪神渗透阴谋，无数天才武者临场失控、发挥失常，各大主城顶尖人才折戟无数，竞争残酷到极致。
就是在这样绝境一般的考场局势里，他们凰溪岛走出去的两个少年，硬生生杀出重围。
清冷绝世的才依依，登顶武道高考状元，冠绝全国，压服所有主城世家天才。
曾经被全岛嘲讽、嫌弃、断定终生无武途的底层废柴贾黑米，逆势翻盘，一路过关斩将，最终拿下全国探花席位！
一个状元，一个探花！
双双杀入全国武道前三，双双斩获顶级武道大学保送名额！
这份成绩，放在任何一座主城都是天花板级别的荣耀，更何况是背靠废土、地处边境、资源贫瘠、常年被主城轻视的凰溪岛！
数十年了。
凰溪岛屹立都市废土交界，世代镇守心灵地狱浅层裂缝，岛上武者无数，修行者代代更迭，却从未有一届武道高考，能打出如此惊天战绩。

往届最优者，不过堪堪挤入全国前百，勉强考入二流武道大学，已是全岛追捧的天才。
而这一次，贾黑米与才依依，直接将凰溪岛的名号，狠狠钉在了全国武道新生代的最顶端！
“来了！
快看！
跨海车队过来了！”
人群最前方，有人骤然高声呐喊，声音穿透嘈杂人海，瞬间点燃全场气氛。
所有人齐刷刷抬头远眺。
海面尽头，一队制式黑色武道警备车队破浪驶来，为首的主城荣誉礼车通体鎏金，在日光下熠熠生辉，象征着武道高考前三甲的无上殊荣。
车队匀速驶过跨海大桥，朝着凰溪岛主城区缓缓驶入，稳稳压过一路海风，气势磅礴。
人群瞬间沸腾，欢呼呐喊声铺天盖地响起，震彻整座海岛街巷。
“回来了！
我们的少年回来了！”
“贾黑米！
才依依！”
“好样的！
不愧是我们凰溪岛的骄傲！”
content_en:
The sea breeze on Huangxi Island always carries a unique moist and warm feeling.
The blue sea is sparkling, and the gray fog at the junction of the wastelands in the distance is completely dispelled by the blazing midday sun. Under the clear sky, the cross-sea sightseeing bridge stretches straight across the sea, connecting the main city with this border practice holy land.
Today's Huangxi Island is completely different from the past.
There is no frolicking and noisy resort tourists, and there is no daily hard shouting of martial arts apprentices. The entire island is filled with a heated atmosphere that is boiling to the extreme from top to bottom.
Both sides of the main road were already crowded with people, and all the shops along the street were closed voluntarily. Tens of thousands of islanders gathered on both sides of the street, eagerly awaiting, and their eyes fixed on the end of the cross-sea bridge.
Colorful flags were hung high along the street, red banners rustled fiercely in the wind, and the pen and ink were sonorous, filled with the pride and excitement of everyone on Huangxi Island.
[Congratulations to the young man from Huangxi for your triumphant victory in the martial arts college entrance examination!
[Jia Heimi and Cai Yiyi, the two prides of our island, return home with honor!
[The young man broke through the wall, the poor family counterattacked, and the glory of Huangxi continued!
The moment the news spread back to Huangxi Island, the entire island was completely blown away.
Everyone knows that this year's National Martial Arts College Entrance Examination is the most dangerous and weird one in a century.
Before the exams, mental whispers and chaos broke out in many places. Evil gods infiltrated the exam halls and conspiracies were hidden. Countless talented warriors lost control and performed abnormally on the spot. Top talents in major major cities suffered countless defeats. The competition was extremely cruel.
It was in such a desperate situation in the examination room that the two young men who walked out of Huangxi Island managed to break out of the encirclement.
The cold and peerless Cai Yiyi has reached the top of the martial arts college entrance examination, the best in the country, and overwhelms all the geniuses from the main city's aristocratic families.
Jia Heimi, a low-level good-for-nothing who was once ridiculed, despised by the whole island, and judged to have no future in martial arts, bucked the trend, made a comeback, and finally won the top spot in the country!
One champion, one third overall!
Both reached the top three in martial arts in the country, and both won admission spots to top martial arts universities!
This achievement is a ceiling-level honor for any major city, let alone Huangxi Island, which is backed by wasteland, located on the border, has poor resources, and has been despised by the main city all year round!
For decades.
Huangxi Island stands at the junction of urban wasteland, guarding the shallow cracks of the spiritual hell for generations. There are countless warriors on the island, and practitioners have changed from generation to generation, but there has never been a martial arts college entrance examination that can achieve such a shocking result.
The top performer in the past years could barely make it into the top 100 in the country, barely admitted to a second-rate martial arts university, and was already a genius sought after by the entire island.
But this time, Jia Heimi and Cai Yiyi directly put the name of Huangxi Island at the top of the new generation of martial arts in the country!
"Coming!
Look!
The cross-sea convoy is coming! "
At the front of the crowd, someone suddenly shouted loudly, and his voice penetrated the noisy crowd, instantly igniting the atmosphere of the entire place.
Everyone looked up and looked into the distance.
At the end of the sea, a standard black martial arts police convoy came through the waves. The main city's honor car headed by it was gilded and shone in the sun, symbolizing the supreme honor of the top three in the martial arts college entrance examination.
The motorcade drove across the sea-crossing bridge at a constant speed and slowly entered the main urban area of ​​Huangxi Island, steadily riding through the sea breeze with majestic momentum.
The crowd instantly erupted into excitement, and cheers and shouts rang out overwhelmingly, shaking the entire island streets.
"Back!
Our boy is back! "
“Jahemi!
Cai Yiyi! "
"Well done!
It is indeed the pride of our Huangxi Island! "
